# Family Handyman

> > Comprehensive DIY home improvement resource covering woodworking, plumbing, electrical work, and home maintenance projects.

Family Handyman provides expert tutorials, tool reviews, and practical advice for homeowners and DIY enthusiasts. Content features contributions from experienced professionals including Jenny Stanley, Alexa Erickson, Chris Deziel, and Gary Wentz, covering everything from basic repairs to advanced workshop techniques.

## Key Topics

- DIY Plumbing
- Woodworking Tips
- Electrical Safety
- Home Maintenance
- Crawlspace Management
- Tamper-Resistant Outlets
- Electrical Code Compliance
- Tool Techniques
- Home Foundation
- HVAC Installation
- Workshop Projects
- Child Safety
- Power Tools
- Home Improvement
- Carpentry

## Woodworking & Tool Techniques

- [How to Cut Straight With a Circular Saw](https://www.familyhandyman.com/article/how-to-cut-straight-with-a-circular-saw): Jeff Gorton demonstrates technique for making straight cuts with circular saw
- [How to Use a Band Saw: Essential Band Saw Tips & Tricks](https://www.familyhandyman.com/article/how-to-make-45-degree-cuts-with-bandsaw): Expert band saw techniques for curves, resawing, and metal cutting
- [Running Compressed Air Lines in a Shop](https://www.familyhandyman.com/article/running-compressed-air-lines-in-a-shop): Guide to choosing pipe materials for compressed air line installation
- [Tapering Jig — Workshop Tip](https://www.familyhandyman.com/article/tapering-jig): DIY tapering jig build for making angled cuts on table saw
- [Miter Saw Tuneup — Shop Tip](https://www.familyhandyman.com/article/miter-saw-tuneup): Quick fix for calibrating miter saw to cut square using framing square

## Plumbing Repairs & Maintenance

- [How to Cut Cast Iron Pipe With A Recip Saw Blade](https://www.familyhandyman.com/article/cutting-cast-iron-pipe): Tutorial on cutting cast iron pipe using Lenox diamond recip saw blade
- [Why Does My Toilet Whistle When Flushed?](https://www.familyhandyman.com/article/toilet-whistles-when-flushed): Troubleshooting guide for toilet whistling: fill valve and supply fixes
- [The Two Things You Should NEVER Throw Down The Drain](https://www.familyhandyman.com/article/two-things-you-should-never-throw-down-the-drain): Plumbing advice from Mr. Rooter on preventing drain clogs and backups
- [Guide To Water Storage Tanks](https://www.familyhandyman.com/article/guide-to-water-storage-tanks): Overview of pressure tanks and atmospheric tanks for well pump systems

## Electrical Safety & Installation

- [Where Is a Tamper Resistant Outlet Required?](https://www.familyhandyman.com/article/tamper-resistant-outlet): Electrical safety guide on tamper-resistant outlet requirements and codes

## Home Foundation & Structural

- [What You Need to Know About a Home's Crawlspace](https://www.familyhandyman.com/article/what-you-need-to-know-about-a-homes-crawlspace): Guide to crawlspace basics, ventilation, encapsulation, and storage
- [What To Know About Adding Space with a Bump Out](https://www.familyhandyman.com/article/bump-out): Guide to bump out additions: cantilever construction for home expansion

## Materials & Finishing

- [What is Milk Paint: Uses, Benefits & DIY Tips](https://www.familyhandyman.com/article/what-is-milk-paint): Guide to eco-friendly milk paint: benefits, uses, and DIY application tips
- [How to Cut Threaded Rod: Best Way for Perfect Length](https://www.familyhandyman.com/article/cutting-threaded-rod): Technique for cutting threaded rod with hacksaw while protecting threads

## Product Reviews & Tools

- [Mini Air Jack for When You Need a Little Lift](https://www.familyhandyman.com/article/mini-air-jack-for-when-you-need-a-little-lift): Product review of AirShim inflatable leveling tool for cabinets & appliances
- [Vivosun Compost Bin Review 2023: Best for Outdoors?](https://www.familyhandyman.com/article/vivosun-compost-bin): Review of Amazon bestselling Vivosun tumbler composter with dual chambers
